# Leadta

> Leadta is a web app to find local businesses to contact by category and area, analyze their public information and reach them by WhatsApp and Gmail. (ES: Leadta es una app web para encontrar negocios locales por rubro y zona, analizarlos y contactarlos por WhatsApp y Gmail.)

Available in Spanish (default, no URL prefix) and English (under `/en`).

## What it does

- Business search: search local businesses by category (rubro) and area (zona); each result includes phone, email, website and social profiles when public.
- Pain analysis: analysis of public information about each business to detect pain points.
- Outreach: send messages to leads by WhatsApp and Gmail, immediately or scheduled.
- Lead Suite: light CRM to record contacts, track status (contacted, replied, meeting, won, lost) and measure reply rate.
- Export: download each batch as CSV or XLSX.
- History: every search batch is saved in the user's history.

## Plans (monthly, no annual option)

- Starter: US$15 / ARS 25,000 per month. 350 credits per month. Monthly limits: 150 WhatsApp messages, 150 emails, 20 scheduled messages.
- Growth: US$50 / ARS 75,000 per month. 1,750 credits per month. Monthly limits: 750 WhatsApp messages, 750 emails, 100 scheduled messages.
- Custom: tailored to volume and channels, agreed directly over WhatsApp from the pricing page.

## MCP

- [MCP server](https://leadta.app/api/mcp): endpoint for AI clients to work with the user's Leadta account.
- Authentication: OAuth. Discovery at [/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource](https://leadta.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) and [/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server](https://leadta.app/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server).
- Requires a paid plan.
- Scopes:
  - `read`: read leads, batches, contacts, message models, stats and account.
  - `write`: create and edit leads, contacts, message models and the commercial profile; delete records.
  - `credits`: actions that spend credits (business and people searches, batch filters, paid pain analysis).
  - `send`: send emails and WhatsApp messages and create meetings.
- Rate limit: 60 calls per minute per connection.
- Tokens: access token valid 1 hour; refresh token valid 30 days.
- Two-step changes: credit spends, deletes, lead edits and every send use a `propose_*` tool that returns a summary and a confirmation token; `confirm_change` runs it only after the user approves. Confirmation tokens expire in 15 minutes.
